A priest has spoken out after being called to the Xewkija residence at the centre of bizarre claims that a family was attacked by a “ghost” in the middle of the night.

According to Talk.mt, who spoke directly to the unnamed priest, police went to get him during the night and asked him to accompany them to the residence following the incident.

“What I can tell you is that the police came for me at night so I could go to the residence,” the priest told the outlet.

He declined to reveal further details about what he encountered inside, explaining that a family involved in the incident is currently going through trauma and that it would therefore not be prudent for him to comment at this stage.

However, the priest indicated that he may speak about what happened at a later date.

The development follows claims that a group staying at the Xewkija residence called 112 after allegedly experiencing a series of unexplained incidents, including one person claiming to have been physically attacked by a human-like figure.

The priest’s comments come as the bizarre case continues to attract attention, with local paranormal groups Malta Paranormal and Gozo Paranormal Investigations even offering to carry out a “lockdown investigation” inside the Xewkija residence.
